rootCause: The preflight plan is built before publish-scope filtering. It marks dependency chains satisfied, then Get-ReleasePreflightApplyItems removes pending type=data APPLY items without revalidating APPLY descendants against the filtered graph.
whyNoSupportedPath: Retrying the same releaseTag reproduces the same deterministic plan and live-state failure.
Editing the package, manifest, SQL, preflight plan, or migration ledger would break the frozen committed-input contract.
Using with-data would require a different package scope and would execute unrelated business-data migrations outside the approved code-only release boundary.
Manually applying skipped SQL would be an unapproved fallback and would not address the second pending data dependency chain.
formalFixSurface: IntRuoyiBackend/script/release/release_preflight_plan.py and its tests must become publish-scope aware and reject APPLY descendants of pending excluded data ancestors.
The maintenance copy and publish-int-ruoyi.ps1 contract tests must be kept in sync so filtering cannot occur after a passed dependency plan without revalidation.
20260721_form_center_menu_under_basic_data metadata and test require formal classification review because the SQL changes menu/package/role structure rather than ordinary business data.
The unrelated dependency from 20260730_mes_process_pool_foundation to 20260729_dcc_product_catalog_remove_subsidiary_source requires a formal dependency-graph correction and regression tests.
